svg.title: Elevations — R04 Master bedroom
svg.desc: Read-only interior elevations from the canonical master; HD-11 levels are homeowner-stated or derived and unmeasured; wall names by compass.
svg.text: 12'-6" x 15'-4.5" · every wall seen from inside · named by compass · HD-11 levels unmeasured

g.text: Master bedroom – south wall (wardrobes, W03 bay)
Standing inside, looking SOUTH · left to right
LOFT held (H-LOFT: size, design and top not in master)
• W03 Master window: 913 mm wide, sill 0.90 m, head 2.13 m (sill/head assumed) — centred
• The split wardrobe around W03 is approved in principle. These are relationship bands only: size,
shutters and interior design remain unmeasured. Loft support and dimensions remain held; no
• Concealed ceiling curtain pocket: TWO tracks (sheer + blackout, HD-14). Clear pocket width/depth,

Master bedroom – west wall (headboard wall, W04)
Standing inside, looking WEST · left to right
FOOTPRINT ONLY — height not in master (modelled plan position; not site verified)
tenant's bed — queen to king envelope
• W04 Master side window: 1826 mm wide, sill 0.90 m, head 2.13 m (sill/head assumed).
• Items below the floor line are footprint only: their height is not in the master, so none is drawn.
• Tenant's own bed: dashed queen (1524 mm) to king (1829 mm) × 1981 mm mattress envelope, head against this wall. Not
joinery and not a tenant frame. Fixed bedside cabinets are omitted by the homeowner (HD-14); tenants may use movable
• Bed-head test wall only (H-MBR-BED; the tenant bed is not supplied): W04 sits at the end away from the wardrobe wall.
• Concealed ceiling curtain pocket: TWO tracks (sheer + blackout, HD-14). Clear pocket width/depth, track spacing and
stack are unverified; the outline is indicative only.
Standing inside, looking NORTH · left to right
• OPEN EDGE 2.90–3.85 m: open to Master dressing — no partition is drawn or implied.
• Dressing passage to R04a is on this wall, beside the TV/door wall; modelled plan position, not site
Master bedroom – east wall (TV wall, D02)
Standing inside, looking EAST · left to right
• D02 Master bedroom door: 861 mm wide, head 2.13 m (sill/head assumed).
• TV opposite the bed: its position along this wall is held, so it is not drawn.

svg.text: HEIGHTS (unsurveyed): except in R05, the 2.959 m band and 3.188 m slab underside are derived from homeowner-stated HD-11 figures and assumed slab/finish thicknesses. R05 only: band 3.048 m and centre approximately 3.277 m are

homeowner-reported. The reported centre conflicts with the older slab estimate; actual slab and panel levels and their construction remain unmeasured. Bathrooms, utility, lobby and balcony levels are placeholders; opening heads are
assumed. Verify all levels on site.
Drawn south-up (not rotated): sheet-top = SOUTH (utility/washing), sheet-bottom = NORTH (entrance/balcony), sheet-left = EAST (kitchen/dining/living), sheet-right = WEST (bedrooms).

Compass: approximate homeowner north, recorded in the master (visualization_geometry.orientation): entrance/balcony/stairs face NORTH. Cardinal directions only — true bearing and magnetic declination are not surveyed.

† marks an opening that is assumed, a placeholder, centred-but-unmeasured, or (PN1) a built niche whose size is unmeasured. Window and door positions are modelled plan positions, not site verified; sills and heads are assumptions.

Held items (red dashed) are not approved layouts. The 2.939 m children’s curtain top is an assumed HD-11 drawing level, not measured hardware. Living, master and children’s concealed curtain pockets need two tracks (sheer + blackout,
HD-14); their clear sizes are unverified.

Dimensions in metres unless marked mm. Wall names are compass directions; the small sheet tags (e.g. master-s) are only drawing IDs. Items without a height in the master are shown as footprints below the floor line.
REVIEW DRAFT · read-only drawing from the canonical master · not a construction release · unmeasured levels and sizes marked
